retraction.reason: Retracted in M42 batch 15 under brief §1: the record earns no honest edge. The English article, at revision 1372930206, traces the convention to a General Assembly resolution of December 1960 "following incidents of antisemitism in several parts of the world" and to an Economic and Social Council draft on racial prejudice; the only record this atlas holds that it names is `charter-of-the-united-nations`, and it names it as the instrument such hatred violates rather than as anything the convention answered. That is a legal citation and not a consequence. It waits on a record of the 1960 resolution, or on the decolonisation of Africa that the drafting years turn on.
